about: What each of our SFSE dlls declares to SFSE and checks for itself, read from its source (FAL-246 item 3; FAL-247 document native-launcher-contract). tests/test_native_components.py holds every field to the source, so a source change that moves a pin fails until this file follows. No hash here: a dll's sha256, size, source_commit and artifact_receipt come from a real build receipt into the runtime's `native` entry in scripts/launcher_recipes/known_runtimes.json, and that entry must agree with this file (same test). The launcher's comparison (src/fo4sf/launcher/runtimes.py) is The Lone Wanderer's.

address_library.why: SFSE checks that a plugin marked as an Address Library user has the file beside it (sfse/FOCCSidecar/README.md); the dlls that read ids also check the header themselves (format 5, this runtime, 8-byte pointers)

refuse_causes.address_library: The Address Library file versionlib-1-16-244-0.bin is missing, unreadable, or for another game version.
refuse_causes.channel: The menu's data channel did not find the game objects it expects.
refuse_causes.channel_ids: An id the menu's data channel needs failed its check against the game.
refuse_causes.close: The game's interface was not there to close our menu.
refuse_causes.create: The game could not create our menu.
refuse_causes.ctor: The menu's constructor in the game is not the one the dll expects.
refuse_causes.id: An Address Library id the dll needs is missing or points outside the game.
refuse_causes.image: The running game executable is not the image the dll expects.
refuse_causes.ini: A setting in the dll's own ini is malformed.
refuse_causes.key_thread: The dll could not start its key watcher.
refuse_causes.listen: SFSE did not give the dll the interface it needs.
refuse_causes.object: A game object the dll reads is not where or what it expects.
refuse_causes.page: The string reader's self-test or the player's actor-value slot did not match what the dll expects; those reads show ? and the dll keeps running. (A form-list refusal is step object.)
refuse_causes.page_ids: An id a page needs failed its check against the game.
refuse_causes.pages: The page kit's own check failed, so the kit stays off.
refuse_causes.register: The game would not register our menu.
refuse_causes.rtti: A game type the dll checks by name is not the one it expects.
refuse_causes.runtime_dir: FO4SF-Runtime.ini is missing or malformed, or the save folder it names does not exist.
refuse_causes.slots: A game function table is not the one the dll expects.
refuse_causes.toggle: The game's interface was not there to show or hide our menu.
refuse_causes.version: The game is not Starfield 1.16.244, the only version this dll runs on.
refuse_causes.world: The world overlay probe's ini settings or movie stage are not usable, so the overlay probe runs alone.
refuse_causes.world_key_thread: The dll could not start the world overlay's key watcher.
refuse_causes.world_toggle: No world overlay menu name is set (WorldMenu empty: census only), or the game's UI had no registered menu by that name, or was not up yet; nothing was sent.
